div.div:
The loop that matters
Upload in any order → Kredibel reads, checks and reconciles each month → the dashboard says what needs you → each fix in Review re-reconciles that month → every number opens on the page it came from. People confirm or correct what the AI decided on Labels; Runs shows each call behind it.
